cycle_automation.title: Cycle automation
cycle_automation.description: Move the work items of a cycle from some states to another when the cycle starts or completes. Each rule runs once per cycle. Turning a rule on does not move work items of cycles that already started or completed; use "Move work items" on a cycle for that.

move.description: Moves every work item of this cycle that is in one of the selected states to the target state, in one batch.
